inputs.text: France has to confront antisemitism, but fighting hatred cannot become a pretext for unchecked surveillance of religious minorities. The rulings against MIVILUDES underscore how easily state power can intrude on people with fewer resources to contest it. Secularism should mean equal freedom and public institutions held to transparency and due process—not a blank cheque for unelected officials to scrutinize people’s lives.
